description.value: Oceanside Pizza Palace & QB Donuts is a pizza restaurant located in Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, with the name suggesting a secondary donut offering. Operating out of a unit at 678 Memorial Avenue, the business runs an active Square online ordering system with in-store pickup. It sits along the popular Oceanside cycling corridor on Vancouver Island's east coast, making it a practical food stop for touring cyclists.
